page.overview:
What is Adventure Nightmare?

is one of the unlockable characters in FNaF World.

Nightmare looks almost identical to his core series counterpart, but smaller and glossier. He is simply a recolor of Adventure Nightmare Fredbear, with the fur colored black, the bowtie and hat colored yellow, and the stomach, along with the inside of his ears, colored gray. Like many of the other Nightmares, he has claws and tears on his body. His eyelids appear to be lowered, giving him an angry look. He also lacks the transparency his core version has, as well as the black stripe that appears on his hat.

Nightmare is very powerful to use. Like Adventure Nightmare Fredbear, he has Toxic Bite 2, which can poison and damage a target and others nearby. They also share Mega Bite, which does more damage to groups of enemies than Toxic Bite 2 without inflicting poison.

In addition, Nightmare also has Rainy Day 2, which can do lots of damage to all enemies as well as lowering their defenses.
